controls_available: Difficulty 1: 3 fruits, 1 attached, detached depth gap 110–140, view limit ±75°, fruit radius 26–28, basket 220×160; harvest unlock requires 18 orbit samples, at least 96° span, 156° travel, and 4 view sectors.
Parallax orchard canvas: drag empty canvas space to orbit within the level's view limit.
After the exploration thresholds, drag a visible fruit into the basket to harvest it.
RESET HARVEST clears plucked fruit and strike state while retaining the camera baseline.
SEAL THE HARVEST submits the event transcript; no keyboard control is bound by this mechanic.
autonomous_processes: Normal active play has no autonomous orchard process: camera angle, projected branches and fruit, selection, plucks, strike state, and counters change only in input handlers.

After a failed SEAL THE HARVEST submission, the asynchronous verifier response may replace the task with a fresh state; this follows an agent action and is administrative retry handling, not an autonomous active opportunity.

The only no-action callback is a 1,350 ms post-failure setTimeout that hides the fresh-failure banner and restores the idle readout; it does not change orchard geometry, attachment, basket, harvest, or control availability.
The 90-second play allowance is a fixed deadline, not an evolving task-state process.
grouped_control_modes: D_full_orbit: every full-mode canvas_drag occurrence, represented by orbit_start/orbit_move/orbit_end across seeds and attempts.
D_full_harvest: every full-mode fruit_drag occurrence, represented by pluck_start/pluck_move/pluck_end from a visible fruit to the basket.
D_full_reset: every RESET HARVEST click, which clears plucked and strike state.
SEAL THE HARVEST is administrative submission and is not an outcome-phase control mode.

clause_i.reason: Across seed-generated 3-fruit instances, the attached IDs and projected coordinates vary, so no policy q(I_t) using only its own prior actions and task times can choose every correct full canvas drag and fruit drag action. The current visible orchard supplies the missing state, but this static observation dependence is not real-time by itself.

clause_ii.reason: A current screenshot is sufficient for the next orbit drag or fruit-to-basket drag at this difficulty; no future frame is needed because the orchard does not change without input. The configured observation window is 0 ms, so a multi-frame temporal window is unnecessary.

clause_iii.reason: No legitimate grouped control mode has an action whose value or advantage strictly decreases after waiting inside an active opportunity. With no new action, the angle, projections, branch contacts, selection/pluck sets, strike state, basket, and controls remain unchanged. performance.now() duration fields, the 10,000 ms transcript check for drag moves, and the 90-second allowance are clock/validation effects rather than non-clock task-state evolution; the post-failure timeout is presentation-only.

configuration_reports.common_visible_process: None during normal play: event-triggered parallax and harvest changes are caused by the agent. The only no-action visible change is the post-failure banner/readout timeout, which is unrelated to action value.

pre_run.reason: Not applicable because clause (iii) fails for this configuration; no autonomous outcome phase exists whose pre-run rate could override the mathematical result.
